== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Commander Evram Lajaie (Japanese)|Commander Evram Lajaie]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67692 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(21, 6, 469, 623)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>4aeaa16ced0ad8eb3859370fd55f86e2999d705dd83b629251d7a349af49101e</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
